zh: 考察许多独立的小波列组成的集合，或取相关的时间平均时，电场在垂直于传播方向的平面内没有统计上优先的振动取向，这才是这里所说的非偏振光。

对于自然光，统计上各横向方向的平均强度相同，正交电场分量之间也没有稳定的相位关系。
这些独立的小波列彼此不相关，叠加后的光没有确定的偏振态。
不能只依据电场方向随时间转动来判定非偏振光；
圆偏振光的方向也会转动，但它的正交电场分量仍有确定的相位关系，所以它仍是偏振光。
en:
Over the relevant ensemble of independent short wave trains or time average, the electric field has no statistically preferred orientation in the plane perpendicular to the direction of travel.

Such light is called unpolarized.

For natural light, time or ensemble averages give equal intensities along perpendicular transverse directions, and the corresponding electric-field components have no stable phase relationship.
The independent short wave trains are uncorrelated, so the combined light has no definite polarization state.
A changing instantaneous direction alone is not enough: in circularly polarized light the transverse electric-field components have a definite phase relationship even though the electric field turns.
Circularly polarized light is therefore still polarized, not unpolarized natural light.

affectedScope: F1 phase relationship and circular-polarization counterexample only.
